articles.title: Pope warns a 'paradise of machines' could undermine humanity as he opens France trip
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV has warned that a "paradise of machines" could undermine humanity. He raises concerns about artificial intelligence, nuclear arms, and human rights during his visit to France.
